description.title: אדירה כסף - אחריות מעביד
description.summary: This table details the employer's liability coverage for household employees under the Adira Kesef insurance plan. It outlines the insurer's responsibility for compensation payments related to bodily injury or illness of household workers.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת 'אדירה כסף' מכסה אחריות מעביד כלפי עובדי משק בית, עד לגבולות האחריות המפורטים בפירוט. הכיסוי חל על תביעות בגין פציעות גוף או מחלות שנגרמו לעובדים במהלך תקופת הביטוח, למעט נהג בזמן נהיגה ברכב מנועי. הפיצוי כולל גם הוצאות משפט סבירות.

34.4 Special Condition
Payment of insurance benefits under this chapter shall be subject to proof being presented by the Insured that the insured property was indeed lost or damaged due to terror, as defined above, by presenting:
34.4.1 Written confirmation from the Israel Police or Ministry of Defense, or -
34.4.2 Written confirmation from the Director of the Property Tax and Compensation Fund as defined in the Law.
CHAPTER E -THE EMPLOYER'S LIABILITY VIS -À-VIS HOUSEHOLD EMPLOYEES
If expressly stated in the specification the Chapter E - EMPLOYERS' LIABILITY VIS-À-VIS HOUSEHOLD EMPLOYEES is valid, the insurer shall indemnify the insured, up to the limits of liability noted in the specification, in respect of sums which the insured will be obliged to pay as compensation for its liability under the Torts Ordinance (New Version) 5728-1968, in the event of bodily injury or illness suffered, in the course of the insurance period by the insured's household workers - except for a driver while engaged driving a motor vehicle -who are employed by the insured privately and not for his occupation or for any business purpose. The insurer shall also pay the reasonable court expenses which the insured will be obliged to bear in respect of its liability, even beyond the limits of liability noted in the specification.
